text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hmm~, I wonder which pen I should pick.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sparkly, huh... But this blue one might be
brighter and easier to read...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For well over an hour now,
she has been sitting there writing replies to fan letters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She said she'd write during her free time before training
and got right to it, but...
It's almost time to train.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Oh, idea! I can just use a blue pen,
and stick some sparkly stickers on it♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I hesitated to break up their fun time.
It looked like there was only one letter left, and waiting
wouldn't take several tens of minutes anyway. In that case—"
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should wait a little longer.)
(Maybe I'll wait just a little longer.)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, looking good.
It's super heart-throbbing♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Phew! Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainy—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, is it that time already?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sorry Trainy, I didn't notice!
Wait, were you calling out to me...!?
choice_data_list: No, it just makes me happy seeing you have fun.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Being watched makes me blush♡
Did I really look like I was having that much fun?"
choice_data_list: You like this kind of thing, don't you?
You like this kind of thing, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I loooove it!
Making things sparkly and colorful! ♪
Because—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Then you'll make my heart flutter like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I really want you to feel that special spark of excitement!
With what I'm about to give you—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Through my running, and through my words!
I wanna make everything sparkle and set hearts racing!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I know the truth.
The power of heart-throbbing excitement ♡"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I can power through even the toughest training.
This unstoppable pounding in my chest—!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"My fans make my heart flutter just like this
with all their letters of support.
That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So that everyone's hearts can flutter with this letter too.
With their hearts pounding excitedly, they can do their best in their studies and work—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The neatly stacked envelopes.
Every single one was filled with Vivlos's heartfelt feelings for her fans.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ! ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right, let's give training our all too!
So that my running can make everyone's hearts flutter as well♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the fan letters,
Vivlos was brimming with even more motivation.
